programme.title: Iceman Cometh
programme.desc: While a royal guard pursues an evil rapist, they are accidentally frozen. Thawed out to modern-day Hong Kong, the pursuit to uphold justice continues.

programme.title: Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Master Huo's disciple Liu Jing inherits his skills. Years later, Liu confronts Blood Demon to protect Huo's clan, uphold justice, and prove his master's legacy.

programme.title: Full Alert
programme.desc: An Inspector wants to stop a huge money heist led by an escaped convict but ends up engaging in a cat-and-mouse game with him.

programme.title: Twin Dragons
programme.desc: When long-lost twins, famous pianist John and criminal Boomer, reunite in Hong Kong and accidentally swap lives, Boomer vows to save John from the clutches of gangsters.

programme.title: The Hidden Enforcers
programme.desc: A retired police officer trains four assassins to punish wrongdoers who escape conviction. However, his good intentions turn sour when the assassins kill the cops.

programme.title: The Black Panther Warriors
programme.desc: Tasked with retrieving a classified file, the mercenary Black Cougar assembles a squad of elite warriors to embark on this perilous mission.

programme.title: The Iron Fisted Monk
programme.desc: After learning kung fu from Shaolin, Husker teams up with the Iron Fisted Monk to fight against the Manchus who have killed villagers and raped women.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new-one-armed hero - a man who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend murdered by the gang.

programme.title: Fire of Conscience
programme.desc: Detective Manfred teams up with Inspector Kee to investigate a homicide. As corruption surfaces, Manfred unravels a web of deceit that puts the Hong Kong Police Force at risk.

programme.title: Widow Warriors
programme.desc: When the men in a triad family are betrayed and gunned down by a rival gang, their wives decide to take revenge for the death of their husbands.

programme.title: The Magnificent Butcher
programme.desc: In this classic martial arts comedy, Sammo Hung stars as Lam Sai Wing, the disciple of Wong Fei Hung, who gets embroiled in a feud with a rival kung fu school.

programme.title: The Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Adapted from real events, the story is about a police special team fighting underground criminal organizations with wit and bravery, finally wiping out the enemy.

programme.title: Tiger Cage
programme.desc: A team of police officers uncover their seniors' involvement in an illegal plot after a drug operation raid. They vow to bring them to justice and root out corruption.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three men who are close as brothers is put through the ultimate test when one of them gives in to corruption and pursues his love for his friend's wife.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: When two brothers escape poverty to make their fortune in Shanghai, they befriend a powerful mobster and end up battling rival gangs.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: When Master Ko is asked to monitor the relocation of a grave, he discovers that the corpse has become a vampire. He must now use his obscure skill to set matters right.

programme.title: Holy Flame Of The Martial World
programme.desc: A popular tale of a brother and sister seeking vengeance for the death of their parents through the mythical yin/yang holy flame technique is a visual epic.

programme.title: Righting Wrongs
programme.desc: A lawyer decides to take the law into his own hands when a witness and his family are murdered.

programme.title: Century of the Dragon
programme.desc: An undercover detective is assigned to take down a triad boss. However, he instead develops a friendship with the crime lord and is soon torn between duty and brotherhood.

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: An early 20th century family dispute over property. After the death of an aged man, his young widow fights for what is rightfully hers.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: A destitute young man arrives in the city and begins working with his late father's friend, who manages a workshop and is a retired kung fu artist.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples.

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire
programme.desc: Heir to a demon-hunting clan, Ma Xiao Ling teams up with Kuang Tian You, a vampire posing as an immortal detective, to stop shadow attacks and resolve a century-old feud.

programme.title: My Heart is That Eternal Rose
programme.desc: A professional killer reunites with his ex-lover who has become the mistress of a kingpin, leading them into extreme danger.

programme.title: The Dead And The Deadly
programme.desc: A murderous plot to claim the fortune of a wealthy family is thwarted when the spirit of the victim enters the body of a young sorcerer to take revenge.

programme.title: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: Constable Zhan Zhao is constantly at loggerheads with Bai Yu Tong. Unbeknownst to Zhan, Bai is a girl subtly vying for his heart amidst their escalating conflicts.

programme.title: Rosa
programme.desc: Two bumbling cops must retrieve a roll of film containing the criminal evidence against a drug cartel from the informant's girlfriend, Rosa, to track down the gangsters.

programme.title: Knockout
programme.desc: A retired boxer tries to help a new student who is being targeted by bullies.

programme.title: Warriors Two

programme.desc: Unspeakable nightmares awaken in this horror. An American nun discovers her new home, a remote convent in the Italian countryside, harbours a sinister secret.

programme.title: The Fabulous Four
programme.desc: Hollywood heavyweights drive this charming dramedy. Three lifelong friends travel to Florida to be bridesmaids at the surprise wedding of their college girlfriend, Marilyn.

programme.title: Miller's Girl
programme.desc: Jenna Ortega and Martin Freeman are entangled in a complex situation in this thriller about a teacher-student relationship that unravels through a special writing project.

programme.title: Greatest Days
programme.desc: A cinematic adaptation of the musical by Take That. Five best friends have the night of their lives. Twenty-five years later, they reunite for one more epic show by their beloved band.

programme.title: Admission
programme.desc: Cute romantic comedy with funny woman Tina Fey (30 Rock). A Princeton admissions officer has a tough choice to make when she meets an applicant who could be the son she gave up for adoption.

programme.title: Spud 3: Learning To Fly
programme.desc: The third instalment of the South African tale follows a now sixteen-year-old Spud Milton (Troye Sivan) who must navigate the difficulties of being a senior at boarding school.

programme.title: One Life
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins leads this true story of bravery. A London broker helps save hundreds of predominantly Jewish children from the Nazis just before the start of WWII.

programme.title: Fall
programme.desc: A nail-biting survival thriller. After climbing an abandoned 2000-foot radio tower, best friends Becky and Hunter find themselves trapped at the top with no way down.

programme.title: Clifford The Big Red Dog
programme.desc: An amazing canine family adventure. A young girl's love for a tiny puppy named Clifford makes the dog grow to an enormous size.

programme.title: How To Save The Immortal
programme.desc: An epic animated adventure about Russia's fairytale villain. Forced to kidnap a girl, hardened bachelor Koschey embarks on an adventure that makes him a hero he never expected.

programme.title: The Boss Baby: Family Business
programme.desc: Now adults, estranged brothers Tim and Ted must work together again on a Baby Corp mission to defeat a new villain. Features the voices of Alec Baldwin, Eva Longoria and James Marsden.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Morgan Freeman and Tommy Lee Jones star in this enjoyable action-comedy. An ex FBI Agent and ex-mob lawyer are forced to put aside their differences to fend off a potential mob hit.

programme.title: Ride Along 2
programme.desc: Ice Cube and Kevin Hart return for another crime comedy filled with drugs, wedding bells and ridiculous antics. All hell breaks loose when the two travel to Miami for a drug bust.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final...
programme.desc: 'Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning'. The spy escapades of Ethan Hunt and the IMF come to an end. They must stop a rogue AI called 'The Entity' before it destroys the world.

programme.title: Black Site
programme.desc: A deadly cat-and-mouse game propels this action thriller. A group of top-secret military black site officers must fight to survive when a murderous detainee escapes.
